preferences.title: Server address
preferences.summary: Address of your Kavita server, for example http://192.168.1.10:5000

preferences.title: API key
preferences.summary: Your Kavita API key, from User settings, 3rd Party Clients (or Auth Keys) in Kavita

preferences.title: Libraries
preferences.summary: Comma-separated library names to browse. Leave empty for every library

preferences.title: Server address
preferences.summary: Address of your Komga server, for example http://192.168.1.10:25600

preferences.title: API key
preferences.summary: Created in Komga under Account settings, API keys (Komga 1.13 or newer). Used instead of the username and password when set

preferences.title: Email
preferences.summary: The email you sign in to Komga with

preferences.title: Libraries
preferences.summary: Comma-separated library names to browse. Leave empty for every library

preferences.title: Chapter languages
preferences.summary: Chapters in these languages are listed, one group per language. Leave empty for every language

preferences.title: Only titles in my languages
preferences.summary: Hide catalogue and search results that have no chapters in the chosen languages

preferences.title: Catalog address
preferences.summary: OPDS 1.x feed to browse. Its entries are shown as titles, so point it at a feed that lists series, for example http://192.168.1.10:25600/opds/v1.2/series on Komga

preferences.title: Username
preferences.summary: Only for catalogs that ask for a login

preferences.title: Preferred player
preferences.summary: Episode lists from this player come first within each dub

preferences.title: Preferred dubs
preferences.summary: Dub studio names to list first, comma-separated in order of preference, e.g. Кіото, FanVoxUA

preferences.title: Preferred player
preferences.summary: Episode lists from this player come first within each dub

preferences.title: Preferred dubs
preferences.summary: Dub studio names to list first, comma-separated in order of preference, e.g. FanVoxUA, Amanogawa

preferences.title: Hide unsupported players
preferences.summary: Only list Ashdi, FenixPlay, MoonAnime and Mp4Upload episodes when a title has any of them
